title: I'll Raise You Well in This Life, Your Majesty!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ellisa, an imperial consort, wakes to find herself back in the past with her young son Leon. In her first life she fought to make him emperor, but the bloody path to the throne ended with Leon taking his own life before her eyes; now she resolves to secure his survival and happiness another way (Tappytoon blurb via AniList/MU). A full-color webtoon from a Korean novel, first released in English.
life_message: A parent's love should seek a child's happiness, not the power the parent thinks will protect him.
